protocol.proposal: frozen exact H2 ANN; routing and all C1 features unchanged
protocol.teacher: frozen H2-pro exact-int8 export; cached original four-prototype logits
protocol.student: original r2/T8; initialize ALL layers from the frozen int8 export
protocol.weight_update: FP32 master weights; int8 round/clamp STE, original fixed per-output scales
protocol.activation: original clip [0,1] and round-to-even uint8; clamp gradient retained
protocol.if: T=8, theta=255, v0=127, binary soft reset; independent per event and layer
protocol.gradient: straight-through round and IF count; no surrogate changes to the forward model
protocol.training_backend: dense exact-count reference with FP64 integer-valued sums and scale decode
protocol.inference: exported int8 weights supported by the existing explicit binary spike-add kernel
protocol.readout: unchanged max of two prototypes per class, threshold 0.35
protocol.sampling: all Train-main candidates exactly once per epoch, uniform shuffled order
protocol.evaluation: full closed-prefix events including fixed Proposal rejects; overall/HD/per-sequence
protocol.best_selection: highest full-event Train-dev IoU, tie by recall; epoch zero eligible
protocol.cost: training dense MAC separate from inference-equivalent MAC/AC and scalar/state operations
protocol.numerical_checks: nonfinite loss, gradients, parameters; no finite-amplitude stop guards
protocol.timing: layer-serial coding, T is not milliseconds; original 100 ms closure remains

engine.forward_precision: FP64 exact integer sums/scale decode, FP32 original logits

posthoc_recall_qualified.definition: overall Recall and HD Recall both >= frozen ANN on the same Dev; descriptive post-hoc only

timing.scope: cached training/evaluation/checkpoint/log loop; excludes startup, cache preparation and idle gap

decision.reason: Late IoU improvement is small, recall/precision tradeoff persists and AC rises
decision.next_recommended: Frozen-checkpoint score/PR and threshold diagnosis on epochs 88,95,100 (36 as high-recall reference); choose calibration on Main and retain 0.35 comparison on Dev
decision.following_if_needed: One-factor HD/teacher-error training objective adaptation in an independent version, without changing structure or combining AC regularization at the same time

limitations: 100 checkpoints selected on same Dev, not final validation
no saved PR/AP or Dev loss, cannot prove calibration-only cause or overfitting
dense count reference inference and sample-level explicit spike checks; no board energy/latency measurements
